p.src: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah.

en: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah.

p.src: 1  As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

en: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
u.src: 1  As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

p.src: 2  My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
u.src: 2  My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

p.src: 3  My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

en: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
u.src: 3  My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

p.src: 4  These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

en: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
u.src: 4  These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

p.src: 5  Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
u.src: 5  Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

p.src: 6  My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

en: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
u.src: 6  My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

p.src: 7  Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

en: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
u.src: 7  Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

p.src: 8  The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

en: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
u.src: 8  The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

en: 42:8 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 9  I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

en: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
u.src: 9  I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

p.src: 10  As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

en: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
u.src: 10  As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

p.src: 11  Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
u.src: 11  Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
